name: listbox
pattern: A permanently visible listbox following the WAI-ARIA APG Listbox Pattern
responsibility: Provide option selection, ARIA, keyboard interaction, state outputs, and selection events without generating elements or content.

authorMarkup.root: A native <ul> or <ol> with data-controller="listbox", named by consumer-authored aria-label or aria-labelledby
authorMarkup.option: Native <li> descendants with data-listbox-target="option" and nonempty data-listbox-value
authorMarkup.initialSelection: data-listbox-value-value is a comma-separated selection set. When absent, initialize from aria-selected="true". Option values must not contain commas.
authorMarkup.content: The controller does not generate elements or content.

semanticElements: The root is ul or ol.
Options are li descendants of the root.
options: Roles are absent or consistent with listbox/option.
contractValidation.invalidMarkup: Invalid markup emits one warning per connection and disables ARIA, listeners, state, and selection manipulation.

completion.warning: List completed attributes using "Added <attributes>. Include them in your markup." Warn once per connection using a flag separate from the enhancement-disabling warning.
completion.excluded: Root tabindex is required for controller behavior and does not produce a completion warning.

contractValidation.warning: The warning identifies listbox controller, expected markup, and the violated condition.

values.description: Current selection set. Assignment emits no events.

select(value).description: Select a registered option without programmatic events.

deselect(value).description: Deselect an option without programmatic events.

selectAll().description: Select all eligible options in multiple mode without programmatic events.

clear().description: Clear the selection without programmatic events.

events.programmatic: Properties, methods, initialization, dynamic reconciliation, and disconnect/reconnect emit no events.

selection.single: multiple=false permits at most one selected option. Space or pointer activation selects the active option.
selection.multiple: multiple=true toggles with Space; Shift+Arrow also toggles the destination option.
selection.disabled: Options with aria-disabled="true" or hidden are excluded from navigation/pointer selection; existing selection is retained while data-state=disabled is output.

keyboard.focusModel: Keep DOM focus on the root and identify the active option through aria-activedescendant. Options do not participate in the tab sequence.
keyboard.ArrowUp: Previous enabled visible option, wrapping at the boundary
keyboard.ArrowDown: Next enabled visible option, wrapping at the boundary
keyboard.Space: Select or toggle the active option
keyboard.ShiftArrow: Select or toggle the destination option in multiple mode
keyboard.typeahead: Append an unmodified printable character to the typeahead buffer and activate the next enabled visible option whose label starts with it. Search after the current option and wrap at the end. Repeated identical characters cycle through options starting with that character. Match lowercased option textContent without kana/full-width normalization. On macOS, Japanese-label typeahead does not work because non-editable roots receive only non-IME keydowns. Clear the buffer after 500ms inactivity without changing focus, aria-activedescendant, or data-state. Space selects rather than entering the buffer. Ignore Ctrl/Meta/Alt combinations and IME keydowns with event.isComposing or keyCode 229; see the IME section of docs/notes/browser-engine-differences.md.

option: Supply role="option" and ids only when absent.
managedMarkup.preservation: Preserve authored id, role, tabindex, labels, and other attributes, except synchronizing aria-selected, aria-activedescendant, and data-state.

lifecycle: Register listeners/observers in connect() and remove them in disconnect().
Do not duplicate listeners/observers on Turbo reconnection.

observations.environment: Screen readers on real devices and Windows IME such as MS-IME or ATOK
observations.item: aria-activedescendant multiple-selection announcements and Windows IME typeahead behavior
observations.impact: The Listbox selection model and IME guards are fixed. Recorded macOS Chrome/Firefox/Safari IME results remain verified; Windows behavior is not inferred from them.

acceptanceCriteria: Required AAA criteria: 2.1.3 Keyboard (No Exception), with no pointer-only features; and 3.2.5 Change on Request, with controller focus movement limited to user actions or consumer JS calls, never timers.
Meet APG Listbox Pattern role, name, focus, keyboard, and selection requirements.
Pass automated tests in Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit.
Report real-device aria-activedescendant multi-select screen-reader verification as unverified.
Actual typeahead IME behavior is measured on macOS Chrome/Firefox/Safari; see the IME section of docs/notes/browser-engine-differences.md. Report Windows IME such as MS-IME/ATOK as unverified.

testMatrix.description: Synchronize role, name, tabindex, ARIA, state, and ids
Preserve authored option ids. tabs-id-preservation owns the mutation breaking ensureElementId's existing-id guard; do not duplicate it here.
Single/multiple pointer and Space selection, before/change events, and cancellation
Arrows, Home, End, boundary wrapping, disabled/hidden skipping, and aria-activedescendant
Option addition/removal, attribute changes, and reconnection
Warnings and disabled enhancement for invalid markup
Completion warnings for missing attributes, no warnings for complete markup, and distinction from invalid-markup warnings
Printable prefix matching, wrapping, repeated-character cycling, 500ms buffer expiry, Space exclusion, modifier suppression, IME guards, and event suppression for timers
